goal: Query PostgreSQL logs on db-1 around 2026-07-27T20:32:05Z for the failed-auth burst and successful data read — capture source IP, usernames attempted, SQL queries, timestamps, and outcome for each event.
what_to_summarize: PostgreSQL FATAL password authentication failed events on db-1 — count, timestamps, usernames attempted, source IP/client host
Successful PostgreSQL authentication events on db-1 — username, source IP, timestamp, SQL query executed (especially SELECT statements)
Source IP/client hostname of all PostgreSQL connections to db-1 in the window
Any prior PostgreSQL connection history from the same source IP to db-1 (baseline comparison)

params.query:
FROM logs-postgresql.log-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T20:30:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T20:35:00Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
| EVAL msg = message
| EVAL is_auth_fail = msg LIKE "*password authentication failed*"
| EVAL is_fatal = msg LIKE "*FATAL*"
| EVAL is_connection = msg LIKE "*connection*"
| EVAL is_auth_ok = msg LIKE "*authentication*" AND NOT (msg LIKE "*failed*")
| EVAL is_select = msg LIKE "*SELECT*"
| EVAL is_statement = msg LIKE "*STATEMENT*" OR msg LIKE "*statement*"
| STATS total_events = COUNT(*),
        auth_fail_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_auth_fail,
        fatal_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_fatal,
        connection_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_connection,
        auth_ok_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_auth_ok,
        select_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_select,
        statement_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_statement,
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name

params.query:
FROM logs-postgresql.log-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T20:20:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T20:45:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
| EVAL level = CASE(message LIKE "*FATAL*", "FATAL",
                    message LIKE "*LOG*", "LOG",
                    "OTHER")
| WHERE level == "FATAL" OR level == "LOG"
| EVAL msg = CASE(message LIKE "*password authentication failed*", "password authentication failed",
                  message LIKE "*role * does not exist*", "role does not exist",
                  message LIKE "*database * does not exist*", "database does not exist",
                  message LIKE "*connection received*", "connection received",
                  message LIKE "*connection authorized*", "connection authorized",
                  message LIKE "*disconnection*", "disconnection",
                  message LIKE "*statement:*", "SQL statement",
                  message LIKE "*duration:*", "duration log",
                  message LIKE "*checkpoint*", "checkpoint",
                  "OTHER")
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first = MIN(@timestamp),
        last = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY level, msg, user.name
| SORT level, count DESC
